title: MAN CITY: SEVEN WINS IN A ROW, THEN THREE LEAGUE DEFEATS IN A ROW
description:
Forest's first home win of the season, and City were on the receiving end.

Manchester City lost 3-1 at Nottingham Forest. Liam Delap scored twice, Jair Cunha got the other, and Rayan Cherki replied for City. ESPN says a mistake at the back led to the first goal.

That's three league defeats in a row after seven straight wins. City are six points behind Arsenal, and Maresca's first season just got interesting. At City, a run like this is basically a national emergency.
